report:
The load balancer figure is built and passes lint and the structural checks, but it is not release-ready. The browser checks, screenshots and a second reader are still open, and the checklist requires them.

**Files produced** (all in `/home/user/Skill-Foundry/runs/figure-craft/315b752ac0574a3a/output`):
- `load-balancer.html`: the self-contained page, with tokens inlined and no external scripts.
- `load-balancer.svg`: the standalone figure.
- `build-figure.mjs`: builds both files from the skill's engine. The engine itself is not modified.
- `lint-report.json`: the lint output.
- `load-balancer.test.mjs`: ten checks on the generated files.
- `REPORT.md`: the decisions, checks and checklist outcome.

**The figure:** one sentence, "A load balancer receives each request and sends it to one of three servers." Size is Figure. A request box travels from the balancer to Server 2 and back on a loop. A green dot on Server 2 marks the server that got the request, and the caption names the dot.

**Checks run:**
- `lint(model)`: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `node --test load-balancer.test.mjs`: 10 of 10 pass.
- `lint-skills.mjs figure-craft`: no problems.
- The skill's no-raw-colours eval case: pass.
- Label size at 390px works out to about 12.6 CSS px, above the 11 px floor.

**Open items:**
- **No screenshots.** No headless browser is available here, and ImageMagick needs approval in this session. Light, dark and 390px screenshots, the console-error check and the reduced-motion check in a real browser are not done. Checklist items 6, 13, 23, 31, 32 and 33 depend on these.
- **No second reader.** Checklist item 34 needs someone other than me to restate the idea.
- **Checklist N/A items.** Rail and margin-note items don't apply at Figure size, but the checklist has no N/A option, so a reviewer has to accept them.
- **English only.** The skill's second-language check is not done.
- **Depth.** The request box is drawn on top, so it appears in front of the balancer when it sits near it. This is a small depth inaccuracy I chose to keep the request visible in the still frame.
